# glinet_dhcp_reservation (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt `dhcp` host reservation. Static reservations may use an address inside the dynamic pool; UCI gives the reservation precedence.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) Reserved IPv4 address.
- `mac` (String) Client MAC address.
- `section` (String) UCI host section name.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dns` (Set of String) Per-host DNS servers.
- `hostname` (String) DHCP hostname.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
